description: Replacement shopfront advertisements comprising new fascia lettering, one projecting sign, associated external LED sign lighting and repainting of the existing shopfront.
decision_conditions:
3 YEAR CONSENT PERIOD:  The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

REASON: To comply with the provisions of Section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Chapter 5).
reference_no_of_permission_being_relied_: The associated Advertisement Consent application has been submitted under Planning Portal Reference PP-15040801. This application should be considered alongside the Listed Building Consent application (PP-15041672), as both relate to the proposed replacement shopfront signage at 361–363 Goswell Road.
